headline: U-Tapao Airport Expansion Advances With Scaled-Back 10-Billion-Baht Terminal
summary: U-Tapao International Aviation is seeking to take over Terminal 2 management while preparing a 10-billion-baht phase 1 expansion to handle 3 million annual passengers in Thailand.
why: U-Tapao Airport is a key transport infrastructure asset serving Thailand's Eastern Economic Corridor industrial development zone.
